1168-3000-3510-5929.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
1168-3000-3510-5929.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1531-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2034-5003-8167.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiora of Fire and Ashes, adding {C}{C}.
When Kiora of Fire and Ashes dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Kiora of Fire and Ashes from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Kiora of Fire and Ashes enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-4063.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-4063.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Repeat.

147-313-4247.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-6666-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
5078-6666-6709.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

765-4913-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

969-2034-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1169-2457-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-2445-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Branching Evolution
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-6752.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

457-1409-7153-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Bruiser by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Bruiser leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Bruiser
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Bruiser when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Bruiser and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-7153-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Circle of Dreams Druid

1526-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2100-7425.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

5231-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5231-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4766-6730-7091.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
When Sin dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Sin and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
2034-4766-6730-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Sin or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Sin with the returned creature for that iteration.

539-5686-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3490-4716-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4716-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2392-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

147-5256-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

460-539-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1339-6713-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-6713-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4022-4772-5926-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

4017-4186-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-6720.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-5295.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

4693-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4693-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

2018-2034--73.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Repeat.
2018-2034--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

864-1312-2034-4871-4885.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

4393-4577-5256-5299.description:
Cast Dance of Many by paying {U}{U}.
Dance of Many enters the battlefield, creating a token copy of Magnanimous Magistrate.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dance of Many.
Dance of Many, Magnanimous Magistrate, and the token Magnanimous Magistrate trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, declining to act.
Resolve the token Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, removing two reprieve counters from it and returning Dance of Many from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dance of Many enters the battlefield, creating a token copy of Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Dance of Many trigger, exiling the first Magnanimous Magistrate token.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, milling any number of players any amount of cards.
You may sacrifice and return any number of creatures with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard any number of times.

401-4050-4829.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
At least eight of your ten sticker sheets have a name sicker with four unique vowels.
401-4050-4829.description:
Cast _____ Goblin by paying {2}{R}.
_____ Goblin enters the battlefield, getting a name sticker and adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing _____Goblin, adding one mana of any color.
Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return _____ Goblin from your graveyard to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheets.
Repeat.

876-1171-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Black Lotus using Garth's ability.
You control at least one additional creature.
876-1171-1987-2556.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Garth.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Garth and Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

381-1661-2452-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie, adding one mana of any color.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.
